description: Build a complete Cruise Planner(크루즈 플래너) trip plan around a cruise the traveler has already chosen: flights, hotels before and after the cruise, and a plan for each port day. First call: ship_name and departure_date (plus nights or embark_port when several sailings share the ship and date). The response gives plan_ref and missing_fields. Answers for missing_fields are accepted in the same call or in a later call with plan_ref. When nothing is missing, planning starts on our side and can take several minutes. A call with plan_ref also reports progress. When status is "ready", share_url opens the finished trip guide (no sign-in needed) and pdf_url downloads it. The plan language and the default home airport are fixed by the first call (user_language). Responses carry status, plan_ref, open questions, stage progress and, when ready, links and plan_itinerary (the day-by-day plan, without prices). Does not search, compare, price or book cruises.

cabins.description: Number of cabins, asked when three or more paying travelers (adults and children) share the trip. Accepted together with travelers or after travelers was recorded.

companion.description: Who is traveling: couple, solo, family (with children), parents (with the traveler's parents), friends.

departure_date.description: Embarkation date, YYYY-MM-DD (local date at the embarkation port). Required on the first call.

embark_port.description: Embarkation port name or UN/LOCODE. Optional; narrows the match like nights.

home_airport.description: City or airport the traveler flies from (name or IATA code). Asked for English-language plans; Korean-language plans default to Incheon (ICN).

nights.description: Number of nights. Optional; narrows the match when several sailings share the ship and date.

pace.description: Preferred pace in port as a short phrase (e.g. "relaxed", "packed"). Optional; accepted together with port_interests or after port_interests was recorded.

plan_ref.description: Reference from an earlier plan_cruise_trip response. Use it for every call after the first. Each response returns a fresh plan_ref, valid for 7 days from that response.

port_interests.description: What the traveler likes to do in port, as short phrases (e.g. "old town walks", "local food", "beaches"). Up to 8.

ship_name.description: Exact English ship name (e.g. "MSC World Europa"). Required on the first call (without plan_ref). Matched exactly, not by similarity; an unknown name returns the covered ships (catalog_ships).

travelers.description: Number of travelers. children are ages 2-17, infants are under 2.

user_language.description: The traveler's language as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. "en", "ja", "ko"). Required on the first call (without plan_ref). The first call fixes the plan language: Korean (ko or ko-*) makes a Korean plan with Incheon (ICN) as the default home airport; English (en or en-*) and any other language or invalid tag makes an English plan, and home_airport is then asked. On later calls it sets only the language of the returned links (ui_language).

walking.description: How much walking suits the group: normal or easy. Optional; accepted like pace.

name: plan_cruise_trip
title: Build a full trip plan for a chosen cruise
